what: Each letter has three copies of itself stacked vertically, and while scrolling the block rises to −200% so the letters roll two steps like a slot machine and appear, each letter .02 later than the last, going from transparent to solid. By default it is tied to scroll from when the title’s top edge touches the bottom of the screen until its bottom edge reaches 75% of the screen. With on: view, it rolls once for 1.2s power3.out when it enters the screen and the panel rises from 1em below. With on: hover, it replays from the start each time the pointer enters the wrapping panel (within), as with the card’s ‹Read more› text.

options.on: ”view” plays once when it enters the screen (headings like the contact title), ”hover” replays each time a hand enters the within board. Default is tied to scroll
options.start: Scroll start position (ScrollTrigger style), default ‹top bottom›
options.end: Scroll end position, default ”bottom 75%” — to run it per section like a large background text, match the section height, e.g. ”bottom top”.
options.within: Element wrapping the scroll reference (or the hover Interaction area) — a selector such as section or .card. If empty, the text itself
options.fade: If ‹none›, it rolls in with solid letters from the start (default is transparent 0 → 1)

use:
LIFE-CIRCULATION DESIGNS

· Contact heading: data-fx-slot-scrub-chars="on: view" · Per-section background text: data-fx-slot-scrub-chars="within: section; end: top top" · Each time it lands on a card: data-fx-slot-scrub-chars="on: hover; within: .card"
